title: 5 Best Resorts in Bangalore for Team Outing
html:
‍1. Guhantara Underground Resort

Location: Kanakapura Road, Bangalore
Highlights:

  • India's first underground resort.
  • Unique cave-like architecture.
  • Activities: Paintball, ziplining, rain dance, and team-building exercises.
    Pricing: Starting at $30 per person (day package).

Guhantara is ideal for teams looking for a mix of adventure and a one-of-a-kind ambiance. The underground setting creates an unparalleled experience, perfect for breaking the monotony of office routines.

2. Eagleton Golf Resort

Location: Bidadi, Bangalore
Highlights:

  • World-class golf course.
  • Facilities: Pool, spa, and multi-cuisine restaurants.
  • Activities: Golf lessons, treasure hunts, and indoor/outdoor games.
    Pricing: Day packages start at $35 per person.

Eagleton blends luxury with outdoor fun, offering plenty of space and opportunities for corporate games and relaxation.

3. Shilhaandara Resort

Location: Ramanagara, Bangalore
Highlights:

  • Nestled amidst rocky hills.
  • Adventure activities: Ziplining, quad biking, and trekking.
  • Poolside team-building sessions.
    Pricing: Starting at $25 per person (day package).

Shilhaandara’s natural surroundings and thrilling adventure options make it a favorite among teams seeking an adrenaline rush.

4. Royal Orchid Resort & Convention Centre

Location: Yelahanka, Bangalore
Highlights:

  • Luxurious resort with sprawling lawns.
  • Facilities: Banquet halls for team workshops, swimming pool, and outdoor games.
  • Activities: Cricket, volleyball, and treasure hunts.
    Pricing: Packages start at $40 per person.

This resort is perfect for teams looking to combine work and leisure, offering corporate-friendly spaces alongside recreational facilities.

5. Golden Palms Resort

Location: Tumkur Road, Bangalore
Highlights:

  • Lush green property with a lagoon-style pool.
  • Facilities: Spa, tennis courts, and outdoor games.
  • Activities: Team challenges and water sports.
    Pricing: Day packages start at $45 per person.

Golden Palms is known for its luxurious amenities and tranquil ambiance, ensuring your team feels pampered and refreshed.

Why Choose Bangalore for Team Outings?

  • Proximity to nature with multiple eco-friendly resorts.
  • Availability of both adventure and leisure activities.
  • Ideal weather year-round for outdoor events.

Tips for a Successful Team Outing

  1. Define goals: Bonding, relaxation, or skill-building?
  2. Pick a resort that aligns with your objectives.
  3. Consider travel time and budget.
  4. Opt for customizable packages to suit team preferences.
